blurb: Guests start with tandem skydives before progressing to solo skydiving through the Accelerated Freefall (AFF) training program. Tandem jumps include instructor control and guidance, while AFF involves structured training and solo jumps to earn a skydiving license. The center provides gear and safety briefings, emphasizing safety and skill mastery.
